Updated: October 1, 2026
BC Seniors Supplement Rates* by Income**
and Marital Status
*Note that this table is provided for reference only. The rate for Seniors Supplement is
determined based on the amount of the federal Guaranteed Income Supplement (GIS) or
Allowance a citizen receives, not their income. See Government of Canada website for
corresponding tables showing OAS/GIS rates by clicking here.
** Income is equal to income for GIS purposes as determined by Service Canada using
information provided on your income tax return. Any discrepancies between income and the
Seniors Supplement should be addressed with Service Canada to assess the entitlement to GIS
or the Allowance.
Tables
Table 1: Amounts for single, surviving spouse/common-law partner or divorced pensioners
receiving a full Old Age Security pension. ..................................................................................... 2
Table 2: Amounts for married or common-law partners, both receiving a full Old Age Security
pension ......................................................................................................................................... 3
Table 3: Amounts for individuals receiving a full Old Age Security pension whose spouse or
common-law partner does not receive an OAS pension .............................................................. 4
Table 4: Amounts for individuals receiving a full Old Age Security pension and their spouse or
common-law partner aged 60 to 64 ............................................................................................. 5
